title: Chapter 1482
text:
Holy Covenant Headquarters.

Han Xiao teleported over. Under everyone's unsurprised gazes, he walked through the complicated corridors and arrived at Destiny's Child's confinement room.

Destiny's Child, who was soaking in the solution, woke up. He happily approached and placed his hand on the inner wall of the container. Han Xiao smiled and placed his palm on it through the container.

At this moment, a researcher walked over and asked curiously, "Your Excellency Black Star, what orders do you have for us this time?"

"Release Destiny's Child." Han Xiao pouted.

The researcher was stunned and said uncertainly, "You're not joking, right? If we release it, it'll be very difficult to catch it in the future … "

"Release it." Han Xiao shook his head.

"Er … Although you're also the leader of Holy Covenant, it's best to let His Excellency Beiger give the order personally …"

"It's fine. I've already told him."

Han Xiao showed Beiger's information and patted the researcher's shoulder.

"… Then I understand."

The researcher did not understand but still did as he was told. He stopped the operation of the information stabilization device and put away the container, removing all restrictions on Destiny's Child.

Destiny's Child was finally exposed to the outside world, but it did not immediately enter the High Dimensional Information Form to escape. Instead, it floated beside Han Xiao and circled around curiously, as if surprised by why it was released.

"You've helped me a lot. I believe freedom is a good reward." Han Xiao smiled and raised his palm to show the Destiny's Child imprint on the back of his hand. "Also, we're already in contact. I hope you can do me one last favor …"

Destiny's Child understood what Han Xiao meant. It nodded slightly, and its body slowly blurred. It entered the High Dimensional Information Form and disappeared without a trace.

"Will there really be no problem like this? If we don't control Destiny's Child, it'll give birth to many more children if there's another Information Form disturbance … "the researcher could not help but say.

"It's fine. That's what I hope for."

Han Xiao waved his hand.

He had formed an imprint connection with Destiny's Child, and his consciousness could communicate at any time. He hoped to use the information connection between Destiny's Child and the many sub-bodies to form a large net and form a new information anchor point.

In addition, he suspected that the composition of Destiny's Child was not simple. Since he entered the dark side universe, he often seemed to have indirect entanglements with Destiny's Child. He had a feeling that perhaps Destiny's Child was not simply a Primal Esper Ability Entity.

"If my guess is correct, Destiny's Child's special ability mechanism might have a special connection with the dark side universe's pan-consciousness. It might even be one of the unconscious incarnations of the dark side universe's pan-consciousness."

Han Xiao muttered to himself, put on the King, and disappeared without a trace.

…

A day later, in the high-level meeting room of the Supers Holy Land's main planet.

There were more than a dozen Beyond Grade As with different positions sitting in the room. Aurora sat in the main seat, maintaining the posture of a mature sister. Her long hair was tied up, and her slightly round and delicate face tried her best to maintain a serious expression. Her entire person exuded a capable aura.

"… I've reviewed the recent reports, and I found that the results of your work have not reached the expected goals of the previous quarter. Although the Supers Holy Land's position is stable now, we're only an organization that has been established for a few years. It's not the time to be lazy. I hope that everyone will take the position in your hands more seriously …"

Aurora had a straight face and a solemn tone as she criticized the dozen or so people present.

This meeting had been going on for a while. She had taken the initiative to call this small meeting to spur some of the upper echelons so that they would not slack off too much.

Black Star had not been in charge of things recently, and Aurora had been acting as the acting leader for a long time. Now, she had also established some prestige. The dozen or so people present also gave her face and silently took the criticism without smiling.

After talking for a while, Aurora finally stopped talking. She slowed down and said, "Alright, that's all for today. I hope everyone can go back and supervise your respective departments and convey my intentions. Meeting adjourned."

Everyone nodded, stood up, and left the room.

Only then did Aurora relax her body and no longer maintain her shrewd and capable posture. She complained about Han Xiao being a hands-off boss and turned to leave through another door.

It was not until everyone left that Han Xiao's virtual figure appeared in the room. He looked in the direction where Aurora had left and smiled.

Although Aurora liked to pretend to be young in front of him, in reality, the two of them were about the same age. Han Xiao was quite happy to see Aurora taking charge. Now, she more or less had the aura of a leader and no longer needed others to shield her from the wind and rain.

"She's no longer the little girl who needed to be protected …"

Han Xiao shook his head and smiled. He walked around.

A weak singing voice suddenly sounded. Han Xiaoxin's heart moved. He followed the voice and came to the floating roof at the top.

He saw Fu Ding holding Chen Xing's hand. The two of them were on a date here. They were inseparable like glue.

The Soul Swapper had already separated their souls, but the experience of coexisting as one allowed them to know each other's character very well even if they were separated. They could guess what the other party was thinking with just a look or a movement. There was no wall of heart that could not be understood. There was only a tacit understanding between them like soul mates.

Han Xiao still remembered the reason why Fu Ding and Chen Xing coexisted as one. It was like a meeting of fate, and in the end, it became the puzzle of each other's lives.

His life had been smooth all these years, and it was also because of Fu Ding's good luck. He had a small part of his military medal.

"Tsk, a winner in life with a wife …"

Han Xiao looked from afar and did not disturb the two of them. He quietly left the rooftop.

He could not help but think of Hella. Speaking of which, he and Hella seemed to have met by fate. On the first day he came to the dark side universe, he had become friends with Hella. Back then, they were still enemies. He did not expect them to support each other and walk side by side until today.

With a thought, Han Xiaoxin arrived at Hella's residence. She built the house directly next to the advanced cultivation room. Even though it was peaceful now, she did not slack off on her training.

At this time, Hella had just finished a round of training and did not continue to stay in the training room. She returned to the room. A strange-looking skeleton beast pounced on her and rubbed against her leg, like a dog or a cat.

Hella's face, which had always been indifferent, showed a doting smile. She bent down and picked up the skeleton beast, stroking its smooth white bones. The little beast stretched out comfortably in her arms.

Han Xiao tilted his head and was a little surprised. It was the first time he found out that Hella had a pet today.

Although this pet looked a little scary to him, in the eyes of Hella, who controlled the power of death, this skeleton beast was probably quite cute. There was a huge difference in aesthetics.

Looking at Hella playing with the pet slowly, Han Xiaoxin's expression was a little subtle.

"Raising a pet doesn't seem like something she would do …"

In his eyes, Hella's personality had always been strong and cold. She pursued greater strength and would not waste energy on unnecessary things. Now, she had a hobby … Hmm, but having a hobby was more like a normal person.

"This is good too. She's finally found some fun in life …"

Han Xiao turned around and left silently.

He strolled around the Supers Holy Land and peeped into the lives of the various Beyond Grade As. He saw that the Beyond Grade As no longer needed to fight with others and were focused on their careers, contributing to the Supers Holy Land together. It was as if most people had found the long-lost peace and tranquility.

Very soon, Han Xiao arrived at the business department and saw that the atmosphere here was extremely positive. In the office, groups of executives were lining up to receive Sorokin's instructions.

He took a closer look and saw that Sorokin's entire body was emitting a faint light. He was in the state of a Hero Spirit Revival. His face was in high spirits, and he was in high spirits as he arranged the business plan in an orderly manner.

Under Sorokin's leadership, the economy of the Supers Holy Land had been booming in the past few years, and its results were astonishing. Sorokin seemed to have found a second spring in his career and found a stage to showcase his strengths. He was not tired of it.

Not long after, Han Xiao walked past all the departments and finally arrived at the Pantheon Square. There were statues of all the Beyond Grade As here.

His gaze swept across the statues of everyone, and the twists and turns he had experienced with the Beyond Grade As over the past few decades appeared in his mind. With the efforts of himself and some peak Beyond Grade As, the Beyond Grade As had changed from a plate of loose sand to a close collection of interests. The establishment of the Supers Holy Land gave everyone something to rely on and witnessed the results of their decades of hard work.

Although there was some hostility between them, in the end, the hundreds of statues in front of him represented the various Beyond Grade As who had fought side by side with him for decades. They could be considered comrades who had carried guns together.

"We can be considered partners …"

Han Xiao closed his eyes slightly. He could vaguely feel the formation of a new Information Anchor Point, so he turned around and left.

At the same time, all the Beyond Grade As in the Supers Holy Land suddenly felt something and raised their heads to look in the direction where Han Xiao had disappeared.

…

Half a day later, Han Xiao, an uninvited guest, arrived at the Mechanical Race territory.

The Mechanical Race was no stranger to Han Xiao. They had once had a grudge with him, so they welcomed him.

A young Mechanic came out to receive him and brought Han Xiao to the guest room.

"Your Excellency Black Star, may I ask why you're here?"

As soon as he sat down, the young Mechanic asked curiously.

"I want to meet Manison this time and catch up with him."

Han Xiao smiled.

Among his many Beyond Grade A comrades, Manison was the most special one to him.

The two of them had loved and killed each other for decades, and he had 'inherited' many of the other party's abilities. Therefore, in Han Xiaoxin's eyes, Manison had a different position and was equivalent to half a 'teacher'. He felt that Manison might be able to bring him a new Information Anchor Point, so he came to visit.

However, the young Mechanic shook his head and rejected his request.

"I'm sorry, Your Excellency Black Star. His Excellency the Mecha Empire is going into seclusion for a long time and will not see all visitors."

"Me too?"

"Teacher has instructed, especially you …" the young Mechanic replied carefully.

"Heh, this guy really doesn't hide it at all. I thought our relationship had eased a lot."

Han Xiao was helpless. He then looked at the young man in front of him curiously and asked,

"You're Manison's student? What's your name? "

"Allow me to formally introduce myself. I'm a new student that teacher accepted two years ago. My name is Marigo Morgan, and I'm temporarily managing the affairs of the Mechanical Race for him. Greetings, Your Excellency Black Star." This person nodded politely.

"He actually accepted a new student, and he didn't even inform me." Han Xiao clicked his tongue in wonder.

Seeing that Manison was unwilling to talk about the past, although Han Xiao felt that it was a pity, he did not dwell on it and expressed his intention to leave.

Arriving at the platform of the spaceport, Han Xiao was about to board the spaceship and leave when he suddenly realized that a new Information Anchor Point had been created.

He looked back at the depths of the Mechanical Race's territory, smiled, and closed the hatch. He then activated the spaceship and entered the galaxy.

At the same time, in the depths of the Mechanical Race …

Manison, who was in seclusion researching technology, raised his head and looked in the direction of Han Xiao's departure through the wall. He did not say much and lowered his head to continue his research. He only muttered a few words under his breath.

"Humph, annoying guy …"
